datatype.$description: Variable OpenType data font, SIL OFL, by Frank Tisellano. Ligature substitution turns text into inline charts: {b:…} bars, {l:…} sparkline, {p:…} pie. Values 0-100, up to 20 per series. Axes: wdth 50-150 (spacing), wght 100-900 (line thickness), mapped to the Lokta type weights. Inherits currentColor.
